workflows.statement: Take one brief from a first idea to three channel-ready posts.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.statement: See what’s going out, when it’s due, and where it’s headed. All in one place.

start.question: What do I need to get started?
start.answer: Create an account with your email and a password, or sign in. Create a brand project, then connect the channels you want to plan for.

publish.question: How do I publish a scheduled post?
publish.answer: Connect a Facebook Page, and its linked Instagram account, under Channels. Hub Direct then publishes to them at the scheduled time. TikTok posts stay in your schedule for you to share yourself.

write.question: Can I write my own captions?
write.answer: Yes. Write or edit any caption in the composer. If Claude is configured, you can also generate a draft using the project’s saved brand voice.

timezone.question: Which time zone does the schedule use?
timezone.answer: Hub Direct shows dates and times in your browser’s local time zone.
